'''Docking Bay 83''' was located in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. [[Muftak/Legends|Muftak]] and [[Kabe/Legends|Kabe]] lived in a section of abandoned tunnels below Docking Bay 83.
